parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly restart the instance. Valid values:

- true: Forcibly restarts the instance.
- false (default): Does not forcibly restart the instance.

parameters.name: orderActionType
parameters.description:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:

- upgrade (default): upgrade
- downgrade: downgrade
